<a id="getOriginalId()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getOriginalId</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.lang.String&nbsp;getOriginalId()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the unique identifier of the first traffic incident.
 <p>The original id remains the same whenever the traffic incident is updated and <a href="#getId()"><code>getId()</code></a> is changed.
 Once an incident chain has been created, this value will never change.
 The traffic incident an be looked up by original id using <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-trafficengine#lookupIncident(java.lang.String,com.here.sdk.traffic.TrafficIncidentLookupOptions,com.here.sdk.traffic.TrafficIncidentLookupCallback)"><code>TrafficEngine.lookupIncident(java.lang.String, com.here.sdk.traffic.TrafficIncidentLookupOptions, com.here.sdk.traffic.TrafficIncidentLookupCallback)</code></a>.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The unique identifier of the first traffic incident.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

<li class="blockList">
<h4>getCodes</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;java.lang.Integer&gt;&nbsp;getCodes()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the list of standardized codes as categorized in ISO 14819-2:2013 standard for this incident category.
 <p>Codes are given in order of importance, so the first item in the list is considered the primary cause of the incident.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The list of standardized codes as categorized in ISO 14819-2:2013 standard for this incident category.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>

public&nbsp;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-localizedtext" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">LocalizedText</a>&nbsp;getDescription()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the human readable description of the incident, possibly with location information.
 <p>The description is currently not present in our map data. Therefore, when
 accessing the data from a picked carto POI via <code>TrafficIncidentResult</code>, then
 always an empty string is returned. This does not apply when using the <code>TrafficEngine</code>.</div>
